name: What is typically included in a full interior paint package?

mainEntity.name: What is typically included in a full interior paint package?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full interior paint package covers all living spaces, including walls, ceilings, baseboards, door casings, window trim, and interior doors. At HH Remodeling, because we handle comprehensive carpentry and drywall, our package begins with thorough surface prep such as patching nail holes, repairing drywall cracks, and caulking trim joints. We mask floors, fixtures, and cabinetry before applying primer and durable topcoats. Depending on your home's layout, closets, stair railings, and built-ins can be included to ensure a unified finish across every room.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full package covers walls, ceilings, doors, and trim, along with drywall repairs, caulking, masking, priming, and multi-coat painting for a consistent finish throughout the home.
